author: Play On Tabletop
description:
Campaign Coming Soon! Check out Wyldwood! https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/tabletoptitans/wyldwood?ref=5bctgt

Adrian from @TabletopTitans is here to do another showcase of the fantastic fun of Wyldwood. JT who played the Urscar Kindred (dwarves) last game is now playing the Witherwood Legions while Adrian plays the Emberhold Ascended. It is unmovable objective versus the unstoppable force. And when we say unmovable we are talking about the Witherwood Legions Yewen, the Withered, and JT will need to figure out how to use his Leader that has no movement characteristic or ability. 

This is a fun one!

Tabletop Titans has successfully launched two Kickstarters in the past. https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/tabletoptitans/wyldwood?ref=5bctgt
